newsitem.headline: TABLE - HCC Insurance Holdings Q2 oper.

text.p: All 1996 and 1997 amounts have been restated to include the accounts and operations of LDG Management Company Incorporated ("LDG") which was acquired May 24, 1996 and AVEMCO Corporation ("AVEMCO") which was acquired June 17, 1997. These transactions were accounted for as pooling-of-interests.

*Proforma adjustments have been made to 1996 amounts to reflect appropriate income tax expense despite LDG's S Corporation (Federal non- taxable) status prior to its reorganization and merger with the Company.
